content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in San Diego

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to verify your education and work history meet the standard before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP bootcamp. Our program delivers the PMI-mandated contact hours through interactive online sessions taught by active certified practitioners. You'll study the PMBOK Guide framework and real-world applications at a pace designed for working professionals.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing bootcamp coursework, create your PMI account and submit your PMP application with documentation of your education and project-management experience. Pay the exam fee directly to PMI. Allow time for application review before scheduling your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence in PMBOK domains and knowledge areas. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE and complete the four-hour, 200-question assessment on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteer work, and publications. Renew your credential and maintain active PMI membership to keep your competitive advantage in your local job market.
